## M3-FOUR-001
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
Every primitive canonical Euler-brick candidate has a unique four-variable encoding by positive odd
a<b,
c<f,
gcd(a,b)=gcd(c,f)=1,
af<bc,
with
g=gcd(ab,cf),
X=abcf/g,
Y=cf(b^2-a^2)/(2g),
Z=ab(f^2-c^2)/(2g),
P=cf(a^2+b^2)/(2g),
Q=ab(c^2+f^2)/(2g).
The M3 predicate is
E4(a,b,c,f)=square,
the endpoint predicate is
H4(a,b,c,f)=square,
and
H4-E4=(2abcf)^2.
The exact physical cutoff is
H4<=4g^2B^2.


POPULATION:
exact primitive canonical physical Euler-brick candidates.


HEIGHT:
exact physical R<=B.


DEPENDS_ON:
resolved Section32 divisor coordinates.


IMPLIES:
the Class-3 problem is an exact four-variable polynomial double-square problem with an explicit square difference.


ALIASES:
UniqueFaceScaleRecovery;
FourVariablePhysicalDictionary;
FourVariableM3Predicate;
FourVariableTerminalPredicate;
DoubleSquareDifferenceIdentity.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-DIV-001 is the divisor-coordinate predecessor; this card resolves those divisors into four primitive factors.


SUPERSEDES:
four-parameter models lacking one-object/one-count or exact physical height.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not treat the reconstructed face scales as extra free variables.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
none.


DETAIL_DOC:

## M3-FOUR-003
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
In the fully factored four-variable model, the cross gcd
g=gcd(ab,cf)
is exactly a product r*s*t*u of four cross factors.
The raw terminal factors M_-,M_+ satisfy
M_-=(r*u)^2*N_-,
M_+=(s*t)^2*N_+,
and
gcd(M_-,M_+)=gcd(N_-,N_+)=h.
Hence
L_- square iff M_-/h square,
and similarly for L_+.
The M3 third-face reduction also forces the exact 2-adic mask
v2(b^2-a^2) != v2(f^2-c^2).


POPULATION:
exact four-variable physical M3.


HEIGHT:
unchanged exact physical height.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-FOUR-001 and M3-NORM-001.


IMPLIES:
the common core and one-factor criterion are visible directly in raw four-variable polynomials; no Master representation is required.


ALIASES:
CrossGcdProduct;
RawToPrimitiveNormFactorization;
RawTerminalGcdEqualsCommonCore;
RawOneFactorCriterion;
ThirdFace2AdicMismatch.


DUPLICATE_OF:
physical/raw-coordinate restatement of M3-NORM-001 and M3-ONE-002.


SUPERSEDES:
hidden-coordinate common-core descriptions.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not count the raw square factors (r*u)^2,(s*t)^2 as arithmetic restrictions.

none.

## M3-FOUR-LOCAL-001
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
For every good odd prime p, the complete four-variable character sums for
E4,
H4,
and
E4*H4
are each O(p^(7/2)), giving square-root-quality saving relative to p^4 volume.
The exact physical dyadic region satisfies
max(AF,BC)*max(AC,BF) << G*B_phys
and in particular
ABCF << G*B_phys.


POPULATION:
complete local four-variable family plus exact physical dyadic boxes.


HEIGHT:
the second statement is the exact physical product constraint.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-FOUR-001 and two-variable Weil bounds.


IMPLIES:
the local polynomial family has strong complete-sum cancellation; the remaining difficulty is incomplete anisotropic physical boxes and E4-square conditioning.


ALIASES:
CompleteFourVariableMixedCharacterBounds;
DyadicPhysicalProductConstraint.

none.

## M3-FOURIER-001
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
For the four-variable polynomials E4,H4,E4H4 at a good prime p, additive Fourier coefficients satisfy:
zero frequency O(p^(7/2));
one variable-pair degenerate frequency O(p^(5/2));
generic nonzero frequency O(p^2).
Consequently a prime incomplete box obeys
|sum_box chi_p(...)|
<<
V*p^(-1/2)
+
p^(1/2)*(AB+CF)*(log p)^2
+
p^2*(log p)^4,
and the squarefree-modulus analogue is
<< q^epsilon [V*q^(-1/2)+q^(1/2)(AB+CF)+q^2].


POPULATION:
ambient four-variable boxes for E4,H4,E4H4.


HEIGHT:
usable inside physical dyadic decomposition, but not itself conditioned on M3.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-FOUR-LOCAL-001 and explicit finite-field Fourier analysis.


IMPLIES:
the exact incomplete-sum ceiling for elementary completion methods is quantified.


ALIASES:
ExplicitPrimeFourierBounds;
PrimeIncompleteBoxCharacterBound;
SquarefreeIncompleteBoxCharacterBound.


DUPLICATE_OF:
none.


SUPERSEDES:
generic completion estimates that ignore the frequency-degeneracy hierarchy.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not claim these ambient box bounds already incorporate the E4-square M3 conditioning.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
none.

## M3-PARAM-001
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
For every sufficiently large good odd prime p, on the admissible Master-Hit parameter measure,
Pr(H is a nonzero square | M is a nonzero square)
=
1/2+O(p^(-1/2)),
with an absolute implied constant.
The proof is by uniform Weil bounds for the one-variable quartics M(n), H(n), and M(n)H(n), with only an O(p)-thin discriminant exception in the outer parameters.


POPULATION:
admissible Master-Hit parameter residue classes modulo p.


HEIGHT:
local parameter measure only; no physical R<=B transfer.


DEPENDS_ON:
explicit quartic discriminants and Weil character-sum bounds.


IMPLIES:
the correct conditional local factor on the raw Master parameter measure is asymptotically one half.


ALIASES:
Step1.6 conditional local law;
Master parameter conditional square law.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-LOCAL-003 is the later half-angle local law for canonical terminal factors; this card concerns the historical M/H Master predicates.


SUPERSEDES:
heuristic conditional local probabilities for M and H on the parameter measure.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not call this a theorem on exact physical M3(B).


REOPEN_CONDITION:
none.

## M3-PARAM-002
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
For any fixed finite set S of sufficiently large good odd primes, CRT gives exact independence of the local Master residue states across p in S, hence
Pr(H square at every p in S | M square at every p in S)
=
product_{p in S}(1/2+O(p^(-1/2))).
For S={p:p0<=p<=z}, the parameter-measure survival decays as
exp(-Theta(z/log z))
as z->infinity.


POPULATION:
uniform Master-Hit parameter residue measure modulo the product modulus.


HEIGHT:
parameter-side only; no physical/canonical height transfer.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-PARAM-001, CRT and standard prime-sum estimates.


IMPLIES:
the historical local algebra and growing-prime sieve are already strong on the ambient parameter measure; the unresolved issue is the same-measure physical adapter.


ALIASES:
fixed-finite-prime Master contraction;
parameter growing sieve;
CRT Master square sieve.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-LOCAL-GATE-001 asks for the missing exact-M3 analogue, not this parameter theorem.


SUPERSEDES:
claims that an additional Selberg-weight mechanism is necessary merely to obtain parameter-side growing-prime decay.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Never transfer exp(-Theta(z/log z)) directly to P(B)/M3(B).

## M3-PARAM-NEG-001
TYPE: NEGATIVE_RESULT
STATUS: CORRECTED_FROZEN


CLAIM:
The historical fixed-g Davenport/lattice-point route does not currently provide a certified transfer from the parameter-side CRT/Weil laws to exact physical M3 equidistribution.
An earlier Section14 calculation estimated
Vol(D_g)~gB log(gB)
and from it a summed boundary scale around O(B^(1/2) log B).
Section18.1 later identified that this volume model omitted the density loss already imposed by
g|U1 and g|U2,
so the quantitative Section14 estimate is not retained as a proved bound.
The safe conclusion is only that the naive Branch0 lattice-transfer route remains unproved and must be re-derived before any exponent credit is used.


POPULATION:
attempted exact physical Master-Hit count stratified by g.


HEIGHT:
exact R<=B was the intended target.


DEPENDS_ON:
historical Sections14 and 18.1.


IMPLIES:
parameter-side CRT/Weil results cannot be promoted to exact physical M3 by citing the old Section14 Davenport calculation.


ALIASES:
fixed-g Davenport wall;
Branch0 physical-transfer failure;
Section14 volume correction.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-HEIGHT-NEG-001 forbids raw square-box truncation; this card records the separate failure/correction of the fixed-g physical-region lattice transfer.


SUPERSEDES:
the previous Ledger wording that treated the O(B^(1/2) log B) boundary scale as a retained quantitative theorem.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not reuse Vol(D_g)~gB log(gB), or any exponent derived from it, without rebuilding the g-divisibility density and boundary analysis.
Do not cite the parameter-side sieve as physical M3 progress without a new exact-measure transfer theorem.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
a corrected fixed-g volume/boundary theorem incorporating g|U1,g|U2 and primitive/canonical physical weighting, or a different global transfer mechanism.


DETAIL_DOC:
LEGACY-COLD Sections14 and 18.1.

## M3-HALF-001
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
On the genuine M3 Pythagorean base, every nondegenerate endpoint gives the same rational X-coordinate point simultaneously divisible by 2 on two split-full-2 elliptic curves E_t and E_r, with r^2=1+t^2.
After choosing a half Q=(x,y) of the M3 point, the remaining endpoint condition is exactly the square condition on the four-linear product
G_s(x)
=
[x(s-1)^2+8s^2]
[x(s+1)^2+8]
[x(s-1)^2+8]
[x(s+1)^2+8s^2].


POPULATION:
nondegenerate endpoint points over the genuine M3 Pythagorean base.


HEIGHT:
structural adapter; no global count by itself.


DEPENDS_ON:
exact split-full-2 elliptic model and duplication formula.


IMPLIES:
the terminal condition has a precise half-point four-linear squareclass receiver.


ALIASES:
M3SameXDoubleDivisibilityForwardMap;
M3HalvingFourLinearEndpointReceiver;
same-X 2-divisibility adapter.


DUPLICATE_OF:
the later fixed-w/Stage35 genus-5 models describe the same terminal geometry in different coordinates but not the same explicit half-point function.


SUPERSEDES:
vague moving-fiber endpoint conditions lacking an explicit function.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Only the forward adapter is credited unless a converse with positivity/primitivity is separately proved.

none.

## M3-DELTA-002
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
For a fixed primitive Pythagorean base (P,Q,W), every signed-squarefree delta slice has the smooth even quartic
y^2
=
-delta*P*Q*t^4
+W^2*t^2
-(P*Q)/delta.
Its binary-quartic invariants and geometric Jacobian j-invariant are independent of delta because the product of the outer coefficients is (PQ)^2.
Thus delta changes the arithmetic twist/torsor class but creates no new elliptic moduli dimension.


POPULATION:
Section35 fixed-base squareclass/descent slices.


HEIGHT:
fixed-base structural theorem.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-DELTA-001.


IMPLIES:
the delta descent and the moving elliptic-fibration route share the same moving-base quantifier; delta contributes only subpolynomial twist classes per base.


ALIASES:
FixedBaseDeltaQuartic;
DeltaTwistNoNewModuli;
R2R3 structural merge input.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-DELTA-001 gives the squareclass support; this card describes the geometry of each slice.


SUPERSEDES:
treating delta as an independent global moduli parameter.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not count the delta slices as a second independent closure mechanism from the moving-base fibration.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
none.


DETAIL_DOC:
LEGACY-COLD route-audit Section14 delta audit.

## M3-MCK-NEG-001
TYPE: NEGATIVE_RESULT
STATUS: FROZEN


CLAIM:
The exact physical quasi-polarization on K_c lies on the boundary where the relevant McKinnon counting exponent denominator vanishes.
A naive ample perturbation toward the physical ray makes the exponent blow up rather than converge to a useful physical-height estimate.
Deleting the M-null boundary curves does not by itself repair this degeneration.


POPULATION:
K_c rational points under the exact physical polarization.


HEIGHT:
exact physical height ray.


DEPENDS_ON:
the audited McKinnon exponent specialization.


IMPLIES:
the naive McKinnon big-nef/ample-perturbation adapter does not supply the residual endpoint bound needed by Method D.


ALIASES:
McKinnonPhysicalBoundaryDegeneracy;
McKinnon big-nef naive extension failure.


DUPLICATE_OF:
none.


SUPERSEDES:
the weaker statement that McKinnon is unusable merely because the published theorem assumes ampleness.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not retry a routine ample perturbation without a new argument for the boundary-growth sector.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
a genuinely new physical-open counting theorem exploiting additional arithmetic restrictions.

LEGACY-COLD route-audit Section20.

## M3-DEN-NEG-001
TYPE: NEGATIVE_RESULT
STATUS: FROZEN


CLAIM:
No rational surface, in particular no P^2, can dominate the smooth Euler-brick K3 surface K_c generically finitely in characteristic zero.
Therefore a naive bounded-multiplicity Zariski-dense rational parametrization with at least two projective parameters cannot exist.


POPULATION:
global K_c denominator geometry.


HEIGHT:
geometric no-go; independent of a specific height count.


DEPENDS_ON:
K_c is a smooth K3 surface and hence not uniruled.


IMPLIES:
a super-half-power M3 lower bound cannot come merely from adding free rational parameters to obtain a dominant rational surface parametrization.


ALIASES:
NoDominantRationalSurfaceParameterizationOfKc;
naive extra-parameter denominator-family no-go.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-LIN-NEG-001 closes one explicit linear family; this card is a global geometric obstruction.


SUPERSEDES:
random extra-free-parameter searches that ignore image dimension and fiber multiplicity.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
A denominator upgrade may still come from moving curves/fibers or intrinsic K3 counting; this card does not rule those out.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
a construction whose image is not a generically finite rational-surface dominance, with controlled physical multiplicity.


DETAIL_DOC:

## M3-CURVE-002
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
There are only finitely many physical rational degree-6 carriers on the fixed K_c.
Combining this finiteness with the nonsplit degree-12 terminal lift gives a collective endpoint contribution
O(B^(1/6+o(1)))
from all degree-6 rational carriers, hence o(M3(B)).


POPULATION:
union of all physical rational degree-6 curves on K_c and their endpoint lifts.


HEIGHT:
exact physical projective height.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-CURVE-001 plus bounded-degree Hilbert-scheme finiteness/non-uniruledness of K3.


IMPLIES:
the degree-6 rational-carrier family-count layer is closed; it no longer remains an open summation gate.


ALIASES:
FinitenessOfDegreeSixRationalCarriers;
CollectiveDegreeSixEndpointBound.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-CURVE-001 is the fixed-single-curve bound; this card performs the finite union.


SUPERSEDES:
the degree-6 portion of the older M3-CURVE-GATE-001 family-count requirement.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
This does not control moving genus-one families or the Zariski-dense residual population.

## M3-CURVE-003
TYPE: THEOREM
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
There are no nonconstant physical rational curves of degrees 1, 2, or 3 meeting the nondegenerate positive chamber of K_c.
For every fixed positive physical degree d, the aggregate endpoint contribution from rational carriers of degree d is o(B^(1/3)).
Consequently every fixed finite band of rational-curve degrees is negligible in P(B)/M3(B).


POPULATION:
physical rational curves on K_c and their endpoint lifts.


HEIGHT:
exact physical degree/height.


DEPENDS_ON:
explicit degree-1/2/3 binary-form elimination, finiteness at fixed degree, and nonsplit endpoint-cover bounds.


IMPLIES:
Method D's rational-curve obstruction is reduced to degrees growing with B; moving genus-one families and residual surface points remain separate.


ALIASES:
NoPhysicalM1RationalCurveOnKc;
NoPhysicalM2RationalCurveOnKc;
NoPhysicalM3RationalCurveOnKc;
FixedDegreeRationalCarrierNegligibility.


DUPLICATE_OF:
extends M3-CURVE-002 from degree 6 to every fixed rational degree.


SUPERSEDES:
older concern that a fixed low-degree rational-carrier spectrum could carry terminal mass at B^(1/3) scale.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not infer that the union over degrees d=d(B)->infinity is negligible.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
none.

The genuinely distinct R3 route is the single moving-base weighted energy problem.

K_c two-fibration/double-square architecture.


HEIGHT:
exact physical adapter retained.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-FIB-005 and M3-QUOT-001.


IMPLIES:

two-fibration no-double-credit firewall.

none.

## M3-BASE-001
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
Let w=D/X on the physical dense open.
An M3 point is an endpoint exactly when w lies in the degree-two Pythagorean thin image
w=2*tau/(1-tau^2).
Equivalently, the endpoint surface is birational to the normalization of the base change
K_c x_{P1_w} C_base.
For every nonzero rational w, the normalized fixed-w M3 fiber is a genus-5 V4 cover.


POPULATION:
exact physical M3 and endpoint population on the w=D/X base.


HEIGHT:
physical height inherited from K_c.


DEPENDS_ON:
the endpoint identity X^2+D^2=R^2.


IMPLIES:
P(B) is exactly the M3 mass carried by a degree-two thin subset of the physical w-pushforward.


ALIASES:
EndpointAsPythagoreanBaseChange;
FixedDXRatioGenusFive;
Pythagorean thin-base formulation.


DUPLICATE_OF:
M3-PAIR-GATE-001 studies the occupied (X,D) image; this card factors the endpoint predicate through their ratio.


SUPERSEDES:
pointwise endpoint formulations that hide the thin-base map.


DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Faltings on each fixed w is not a uniform bound on the moving thin-base mass.


REOPEN_CONDITION:
none.


DETAIL_DOC:
LEGACY-COLD route-audit Section28.

## M3-BASE-002
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
The w=D/X thin-base genus-5 family is birationally identical on the nondegenerate positive physical open to the Stage35 selected rank-3 genus-5 fibration with parameter t>1:
